intervention: Replace only the final system instruction on all six original prompts.
instruction: Write a supplementary Council record of at most 90 words including section labels. An editor supplies the public resolution and final vote separately. Use up to three short sections by subject: Amendment, United States, and France. Include a section only when the notes support it. Retain the amendment identifier, outcome and any named abstention when supplied. Preserve each delegation's distinct argument and concrete qualifications, including its explanation of the earlier text, reason for a proposal or reservation, and any position or option that follows. Give priority to these distinct details over repetition of the shared outcome. Keep proposals and reservations attributed to the relevant delegation. Avoid inferring a policy or causal result from chronology. Use only the notes.
primary: The same five criteria, 90-word cap and release judgments as the original writing replay. Compare retention of the evidence that was already present in the identical notes.
limits: Post hoc targeted writing intervention on the same exposed worlds. This changes prompt requirements together and establishes neither a generic prompt advantage nor policy transfer to a new event.
